title: GetDisplayName - ObjectReference
content:
F4SE Member of: ObjectReference Script

Returns the current name of this ObjectReference.

Syntax:
string Function GetDisplayName() Native

Parameters:
- None

Return Value:
- Returns the current name of this ObjectReference.

Examples:
string PlayerName = Game.GetPlayer().GetDisplayName()
Debug.MessageBox("The player's name is " + PlayerName)

See Also:
- ObjectReference Script
